title: Cross-Head Attention Uplift Network with Inverse Propensity Score under Unobserved Confounding
title_zh: 未观测混杂下结合逆倾向评分的跨头注意力 Uplift 网络
abstract_en: Uplift modeling, crucial for estimating individual treatment effects (ITE), faces dual challenges: flexibly leveraging inter-group similarity to enhance discriminative power and debiasing under unobserved confounding scenarios. In this paper, we propose the Cross-Head Attention Uplift Network (CHAUN) and Robust Adversarial Inverse Propensity Score (RA-IPS) method to address these limitations. CHAUN employs shared feature embeddings and cross-head attention mechanisms to dynamically integrate treatment-specific and control-specific representations, enhancing inter-group correlation modeling. Theoretically, we prove that access to the true propensity scores ensures ITE identifiability even with unobserved confounders. For practical scenarios lacking true propensity scores, RA-IPS adversarially optimizes propensity weights within constrained uncertainty sets to mitigate bias from unobserved variables. Experiments on public datasets (CRITEO-UPLIFT, LAZADA) and a production e-commerce dataset demonstrate CHAUN's superiority over state-of-the-art uplift models, achieving relative improvements of up to 25.6% in QINI scores. RA-IPS further enhances robustness, outperforming standard IPS by 5.4% under unobserved confounding. The results validate the effectiveness of our proposed methods in real-world causal inference tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文面向 Uplift modeling 中个体处理效应（ITE）估计的两个核心难题：如何灵活利用处理组与对照组之间的相似性以提升判别能力，以及如何在存在未观测混杂（unobserved confounding）时进行去偏。作者提出 Cross-Head Attention Uplift Network（CHAUN）与 Robust Adversarial Inverse Propensity Score（RA-IPS）。CHAUN 通过共享特征嵌入与跨头注意力机制，动态融合 treatment-specific 与 control-specific 表征，从而增强组间相关性建模能力。理论上，论文证明若可获得真实倾向评分（propensity scores），即使存在未观测混杂，ITE 仍可识别。针对真实倾向评分不可得的实际场景，RA-IPS 在受约束的不确定集合内对倾向权重进行对抗优化，以缓解未观测变量带来的偏差。实验在 CRITEO-UPLIFT、LAZADA 以及一个生产级电商数据集上验证了方法有效性：CHAUN 相比现有 Uplift 模型在 QINI 分数上最高取得 25.6% 的相对提升；RA-IPS 在未观测混杂场景下相比标准 IPS 进一步提升 5.4%，显示出更强鲁棒性。
key_points_zh: 提出 CHAUN，通过共享 embedding 与 cross-head attention 动态融合 treatment/control 表征，更好建模组间相关性。
提出 RA-IPS，在倾向评分不确定集合内进行对抗式权重优化，以缓解未观测混杂导致的偏差。
理论证明：若可获得真实 propensity scores，即便存在 unobserved confounders，ITE 仍具备可识别性。
在 CRITEO-UPLIFT、LAZADA 和生产级电商数据集上，CHAUN 的 QINI 分数相对提升最高达 25.6%。
RA-IPS 在未观测混杂设定下相比标准 IPS 进一步提升 5.4%，增强了真实因果推断任务中的鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: A solid causal uplift modeling paper with practical e-commerce value, though it is more incremental modeling work than an agentic commerce-system contribution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇具有实际电商价值的因果增益建模论文，但更偏向增量式模型改进，而非智能体化电商系统贡献。
